headline: Türkiye pays $3.2 billion to investors affected by fund liquidation crisis
summary: Turkish Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz announced that close to TL 161 billion ($3.2 billion) has been paid to 445,000 investors impacted by the recent fund crisis without using central government budget funds.
why: Fund liquidations and regulatory interventions affect institutional trust and investor participation in Turkish financial markets.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Substantial investor payout resolutions stabilize retail sentiment following domestic fund distress.
